description: This file sets up CLI commands for Playwright testing, including running tests, managing reports, starting servers, and initializing agents. It imports various modules for configuration, reporting, server management, and agent setup, and defines functions to add specific commands to a CLI program.

methods.name: addTestCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'test' command to the CLI program, with options for filtering, headed mode, retries, etc.

methods.name: addClearCacheCommand
methods.description: Adds command to clear build and test caches.

methods.name: addDevServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to start a development server.

methods.name: addTestServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to start a test server.

methods.name: addShowReportCommand
methods.description: Adds command to show HTML report.

methods.name: addMergeReportsCommand
methods.description: Adds command to merge multiple blob reports into a single report.

methods.name: addTestMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Adds command to run MCP test server for MCP interactions.

methods.name: addInitAgentsCommand
methods.description: Adds command to initialize repository agents.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Executes the test run process with configuration, handling different modes like UI, watch, or full run.

methods.name: runTestServer
methods.description: Starts a test server with specified host and port.

methods.name: mergeReports
methods.description: Merges reports from a directory into a single report.

methods.name: overridesFromOptions
methods.description: Creates configuration overrides based on CLI options.

methods.name: resolveReporterOption
methods.description: Resolves reporter string into reporter descriptions.

methods.name: resolveShardOption
methods.description: Parses shard option in 'current/total' format into shard object.

methods.name: resolveShardWeightsOption
methods.description: Parses environment variable for shard weights.

methods.name: resolveReporter
methods.description: Resolves reporter ID or path to a reporter implementation.
